name: coober_harlequin
theme: opal country at sunset, a fast-tempo MINERAL dive whose colour flashes on the beat: from a grand-design spiral down past the Sun and its rocky worlds to Australia's red centre at the terminator (white salt lakes on rust, the opal fields a speckled pale patch), low over a plain of thousands of chalky conical spoil heaps worked as a commons (red kangaroos, emus, a wedge-tailed eagle, galahs, a perentie, a thorny devil), down a shaft into an empty dugout gallery with an opal seam in the wall, one harlequin opal, its real structure (equal silica spheres stacked in perfect rows, the cause of the fire), the random silica network inside one sphere, a silicon nucleus, and the quark-gluon droplet, which morphs into the afterglow shell (the universe was that soup once), whose mottle opens onto the spiral (the loop home). Palette family: potch-dark opal harlequin & gibber red. Math/space personality: one-size order vs one-size disorder (the opal's spheres all one size in a perfect stack; the afterglow's spots all one size at random).

registers.name: spiral_beacon
registers.palette: cobalt and violet spiral arms, scarlet star-forming knots, a cream-white core, emerald dust lanes, inky void
registers.scene: a grand-design spiral galaxy seen face-on across an inky void, two sweeping cobalt and violet arms beaded with hundreds of scarlet star-forming knots, emerald-tinged dust lanes threading the arms, a soft cream-white core, a scatter of remote galaxies hanging in the void around it
registers.loop_target: a face-on spiral galaxy, cobalt arms beaded with scarlet knots

registers.name: inner_worlds
registers.palette: white-hot star, apricot zodiacal haze, rust and teal rocky worlds, violet-indigo space
registers.scene: the Sun at the hub of its inner system, a white-hot star wreathed in an apricot zodiacal haze, four rocky worlds strung out on faint orbit rings across violet-indigo space, a rust-red world, a cratered grey world, a cloud-streaked ocean world, and a veiled cream one, a thin dust belt glinting beyond them

registers.name: red_centre
registers.palette: gibber rust-red continent, chalk-white salt lakes, ochre dune streaks, violet terminator dusk, indigo night limb
registers.scene: the heart of Australia seen from orbit at sunset, a vast rust-red continent under a violet terminator line, chalk-white salt lakes scattered across the red like spilled shards, parallel ochre dune streaks combed across the desert, a speckled pale patch of opal fields among the gibber plains, the night limb indigo beyond

registers.name: spoil_commons
registers.palette: gibber rust-red stones, chalky cream spoil heaps, violet sunset sky, long purple shadows, rose galah flocks
registers.scene: low over an opal-field plain at sunset, thousands of chalky conical spoil heaps standing in ranks to the horizon across rust-red gibber stones, a mob of red kangaroos resting between the heaps, three emus striding past, a wedge-tailed eagle wheeling overhead, a flock of rose-and-grey galahs lifting off a heap, a perentie lizard sprawled on a warm slope, a thorny devil on a gibber stone in the foreground, round shaft mouths dotting the heaps, a violet sky and long purple shadows

registers.name: dugout_gallery
registers.palette: rust and cream sandstone walls, dusky potch-stone vein, electric green and scarlet flashes, violet shadow
registers.scene: an empty underground opal gallery cut into rust and cream sandstone, empty, no one present, pick-scarred walls and a low arched ceiling, a vein of dusky potch stone running through the wall, flecked with electric green, cobalt and scarlet flashes, chalk dust on the floor, the far end of the tunnel fading into violet shadow

registers.name: harlequin_face
registers.palette: potch-dark stone, electric green, cobalt and scarlet harlequin patches, violet-magenta glints
registers.scene: a harlequin opal set in its seam of dusky potch stone, its polished face a checkerboard of square patches of colour, electric green against cobalt against scarlet, each patch flashing one hue across its whole width, violet-magenta glints at the corners where patches meet, rust sandstone around the seam

registers.name: sphere_stack
registers.palette: milky silica spheres, electric green, cobalt and scarlet diffraction sheen, inky potch gaps
registers.scene: the inside of precious opal, countless silica spheres all exactly one size stacked in perfect rows and layers, rank on rank receding into the stone, each row throwing a sheen of electric green, cobalt or scarlet across the milky sphere faces, inky gaps between the spheres, one stack's rows tilted against its neighbour's at a crisp boundary

stage.element: a silica sphere, a milky opaline glass ball of exact size, a thin sheen of electric green and cobalt sliding across its polished face

registers.name: silica_net
registers.palette: emerald and cobalt rods, scarlet bead-points, violet haze, inky void
registers.scene: the interior of one silica sphere, a random network of linked tetrahedra with no rows anywhere, each silicon bead held by four oxygen beads on emerald and cobalt rods, rings of five, six and seven beads, no two rings alike, a few trapped water specks, the tangle receding into violet haze

stage.element: a silicon atom, a faceted scarlet gem bead with four short emerald and cobalt rod stubs, lit from within against violet haze

registers.name: silicon_core
registers.palette: scarlet and pearl nucleon spheres, electric green shimmer, faint violet fog-shell, inky void
registers.scene: a silicon nucleus, a shivering droplet of fourteen scarlet spheres and fourteen pearl spheres crowded into one rippling drop, an electric green shimmer playing over its rind, a faint violet fog-shell hanging far out around it in an inky void

stage.element: a silicon nucleon, a pearl sphere with a rippling liquid rind, its skin flashing square harlequin patches of electric green and scarlet

registers.name: gluon_broth
registers.palette: scarlet and white-hot sparks, electric green and cobalt strands, violet-crimson broth
registers.scene: a quark-gluon droplet, a fireball in which every sphere has melted into one seething fluid, loose scarlet and white-hot sparks swimming freely, tangled electric green and cobalt strands of light coiling between them, no bound trios anywhere, the whole broth churning in violet-crimson heat

stage.element: a quark spark, a white-hot molten bead wound in a tiny two-armed spiral of cobalt and scarlet light, glowing violet-crimson at its rim

registers.name: afterglow_shell
registers.palette: mottled scarlet and cobalt spots, ember-orange and violet blush, emerald flecks
registers.scene: the afterglow shell, the oldest light there is seen from inside, a sphere of mottled scarlet and cobalt light on every hand, its warm and cool spots all about one size and scattered at random, an ember-orange and violet blush between them, a few emerald flecks, nothing in front of it

music_theme: a driving smoldering groove at a fast tempo, a heavy 808 kick on every downbeat, dark warm synth bass pulsing under the spiral and the Sun, a dry rattling shaker as the dive crosses the red desert and the spoil-heap plain, a hollow resonant drone in the dugout gallery, bright glassy stabs flashing on each beat through the opal's colour patches and its stacked spheres, a tightening gritty pulse in the nucleus and the seething broth, and an open shimmering swell on the morph into the afterglow
